security.classification: Internal use only — DEC-012 (security/privacy authority Brett, 2026-10-08): no PII and no CJI/CJIS data will be stored in the system. See openFindings FIND-001 for the field-dictionary conflict this creates.
security.sensitiveData: None permitted — DEC-012. The prototype's field dictionary currently includes PII fields (DOB, SSN, driver's license) that MUST be removed from the data model before real use (FIND-001, assigned to SPRINT-002 scope). No applicant records exist in the repository.

security.secretsManagement: No credentials, tokens, personal information, or production secrets in repository files (Rule 50).
security.supplyChain: No external dependencies currently. Additions require trusted-source decisions and recorded SP 800-204D practices.
security.loggingAudit: TBD — required for production per prototype README; no decision recorded.

openFindings.description: DEC-012 (no PII / no CJIS data) conflicts with the prototype field dictionary, which includes DOB, SSN, driver's license, and other personal fields. These fields must be removed or replaced with non-PII references (e.g., control ID only) before the tool is used with real applicants.
